subtasks.description: Implement the 8-bit forward AES S-box substitution using a lookup table (256x8 entries). For every input byte a, output the S-box value b as per the AES standard, ensuring corner cases 0x00→0x63 and 0xFF→0x16 are correct.
constraints: Must be purely combinational with no clock, reset, or state elements.
Must correctly map 0x00 to 0x63 and 0xFF to 0x16.
